instruction: Modify slide dimensions to custom size: 9 inches width and 6.75 inches height

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires custom 9x6.75 inch dimensions (8229600 x 6172200 EMU). Verified: 9*914400=8229600 EMU, 6.75*914400=6172200 EMU.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts slide dimensions using prs.slide_width and prs.slide_height from python-pptx library
Metric properly compares both width AND height dimensions against expected values, providing complete coverage of instruction requirements
Expected values are mathematically correct: 9 inches * 914400 EMU/inch = 8229600 EMU, 6.75 inches * 914400 EMU/inch = 6172200 EMU
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('width') and expected.get('height') without incorrectly accessing expected.get('rules', {})
Appropriate tolerance-based comparison (default 10000 EMU ≈ 0.01 inches) for dimension verification
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before verification to ensure modified dimensions are persisted
Robust error handling with try-except returning 0.0 on failure
